prompt: A researcher records devices from two production lines and their inspection outcome, obtaining these observed counts -- Line 1: Pass 27, Rework 16, Fail 33; Line 2: Pass 44, Rework 28, Fail 15. Calculate the chi-square test statistic for the test of homogeneity (df = 2).

misconception_source.label: Built expected counts from the row total only (ignored column marginals)

sources.note: expected counts use BOTH marginals (row*col/grand); a row-only split ignores the column distribution

misconception_source.label: Used equal expected counts (grand total / number of cells)

sources.note: expected counts come from the MARGINAL totals (row*col/grand), not an equal split

misconception_source.label: Divided the squared deviation by O instead of E

sources.note: the denominator in chi-square is the EXPECTED count E, not the observed O

worked_solution: Expected count E = (row total x column total)/grand total; e.g. E[Line 1,Pass] = (76 x 71)/163 = 33.104. chi-square = sum (O - E)^2/E = 13.412.
